claims.statement: For every unordered arity profile r_i in {2,3,4} with 1<=m<=40 in the specified path-and-branches tree family, every rank satisfying x+2<=p and 3p<2alpha+1 has strictly negative complete original favorable-leaf sum S(T,p).
claims.scope: Exact bounded coefficient-recurrence census of all 12,340 profiles and all 191,016 eligible profile/rank pairs; six fixed actual-tree graph-DP cross-checks. No extension beyond this finite family and boundary is claimed.
claims.reason: retained: independent exact replay reproduced every bounded count and found all complete sums strictly negative. The polynomial formulas, strict selector, eligibility guards, alpha=N+2, per-leaf summands, and multiplicities agree with the specified tree and original-leaf contract. The finite result does not resolve the arbitrary-tree target.

limitations: The audited boundary is only 1<=m<=40 for the specified path-and-branches family; larger prefixes and arbitrary trees are not covered.
Graph-DP fidelity was independently checked on six profiles only; the rest of the bounded enumeration relies on the audited exact coefficient recurrences.
Finite central-margin checks do not prove any uniform log-concavity argument or missing mixed-minor bounds.
